description: This file defines the HeaderData class within the OrangeHRM Core Report Header namespace. The class manages header-related data for reports, including columns, group counts, and related properties, with getter, setter, and increment methods.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Manages report header data such as columns, group counts, and related properties, providing methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of columns (including stacked and regular columns) for the report header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the array of columns (including stacked and regular columns) for the report header.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of columns.

methods.name: setColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of columns.

methods.name: incrementColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the column count by a specified amount (default 1) and returns the new count.

methods.name: getGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of groups.

methods.name: setGroupCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of groups.

methods.name: incrementGroupCount
methods.description: Increments the group count by a specified amount (default 1) and returns the new count.

methods.name: getGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of grouped columns.

methods.name: setGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the number of grouped columns.

methods.name: incrementGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the grouped column count by a specified amount (default 1) and returns the new count.
